[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Max Consecutive Ones III** [LC 1004 · Max Consecutive Ones III](https://leetcode.com/problems/max-consecutive-ones-iii/){difficulty="Medium"}

"Longest subarray containing at most $k$ zeros." Fix the right edge and push it right one cell at a time, adding each cell to the window; the window is *valid* while its zero count stays $\le k$. When a new zero breaks the budget, advance the left edge until the window is legal again — dropping a zero from the front as you go. Because the array is only $0/1$, the sole thing the window must remember is **how many zeros it holds**. The longest legal window ever seen is the answer.

[Solved in full in @sec-sw-p2-a.]{.card-link}

:::
